title: b7z9.22.3: C tdma_tx_allowed: accept slot_map array instead of single slot
description: Modify tdma_tx_allowed() in tdma.c (lines 226-261) to check against a slot_map array stored in lichen_tdma_ctx, not just tdma->slot. Add slot_map field to the context struct. Wire slot_map population from beacon parsing. The Python reference is slot_coordination.py:99-122 tx_allowed().
